definitions.explanation: A professional who manages library collections and assists patrons with research and resources.

examples.japanese: {司書|ししょ}に{本|ほん}の{場所|ばしょ}を{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I asked the librarian where the book was.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{公立|こうりつ}{図書館|としょかん}で{司書|ししょ}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: She works as a librarian at the public library.

examples.japanese: {司書|ししょ}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}るために{勉強|べんきょう}している。
examples.english: I'm studying to get my librarian certification.

notes:
FORMATION:
{司|し} (manage/administer) + {書|しょ} (books/documents)

TYPES:
・{学校|がっこう}{司書|ししょ} - school librarian
・{司書|ししょ}{教諭|きょうゆ} - teacher-librarian (at schools)

QUALIFICATION:
{司書|ししょ}{資格|しかく} - librarian certification (obtained through university courses or special programs)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{司書|ししょ}に{相談|そうだん}する - to consult a librarian
・{司書|ししょ}に{推薦|すいせん}してもらう - to get a recommendation from a librarian
・{司書|ししょ}として{働|はたら}く - to work as a librarian
